This '''[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] ore facility''' was Located on [[Gap Nine]]. It was managed by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Icus Traft]]. At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] operatives went on a [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] [[Mission to Gap Nine|mission]] to destroy the facility. The mission was first foiled, but the Rebels managed to escape. However, the explosives planted by the Rebels were never discovered by Taft's men, and the Rebels eventually returned and completed their mission, destroying the ore facility.
